newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita confirms 20 bln yen LCD investment plan.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita confirms 20 bln yen LCD investment plan.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd on Tuesday confirmed a newspaper report that it plans to invest 20 billion yen in its liquid crystal display (LCD) production facilities in the business year starting in April, triple the amount of the current year.

The company plans to construct a new production line for thin film transistors (TFTs), currently the most advanced type of LCD, in its Ishikawa factory in northwestern Japan, said a Matsushita spokesman.

The new line is expected to start operating in July. It will have the capacity to make 90,000 LCDs a month, the spokesman said. Matsushita expects to produce about 65 billion yen worth of LCDs this business year, and aims for annual sales of 150 billion yen by the 2000/01 business year, the spokesman said.
